announcements.headline: Doc re. Half Yearly Report
announcements.insight: Half-yearly results are released following the August B Share Scheme approval. Shareholders should monitor for any updates on the capital reserve cancellation.

announcements.headline: Approved B Share Scheme
announcements.insight: The B Share Scheme follows the July court approval of the capital reserve cancellation. This sequence suggests a structured capital reorganisation to facilitate the new share class.

announcements.headline: Court Approval of Cancellation of Capital Reserve
announcements.insight: Court approval of the cancellation of capital reserve follows the June AGM results. This finalizes a specific corporate action for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the outcome of the Annual General Meeting. This result confirms the decisions made by the membership.
